seasons.dattilo: Open from late April to early November (2026: 25 April to 1 November); these are its spring and autumn hours
seasons.il-tiglio: Open every day for lunch and dinner until 30 September; in the winter months only Friday to Sunday, with a break of variable length in October and in January.
seasons.la-palmeraie-chateau-de-valmer: Open in the warmer months; closed now, its 2027 season starts on 1 May
seasons.la-terrasse-cheval-blanc-st-tropez: Open with the hotel from early May to early October (8 May to 5 October in 2025); closed now, reopening with Cheval Blanc St-Tropez on 6 May 2027.
seasons.osmosi: Closed for its annual break in February (1-28 February per Identità Golose).
seasons.osteria-di-passignano: Closed for holidays from 9 to 16 August.
seasons.singlethread: Closed on 1 January, Thanksgiving and 25 December
seasons.tancredi: Seasonal: closes for the winter after the New Year's Eve dinner and reopens in February (8 February in 2025).
seasons.uberto-restaurant: Closed in summer: from 15 June to 16 September 2027

alchemist.note: Its site gives only the phone line's hours and its Tock page none; closed for its yearly five-month Intermission from December 2026, reopening in April 2027

alevante-by-angel-leon.note: Its own site and CoverManager page give no days or times; Andalucía's tourism listing (andalucia.org) gives only the season (3 March to 31 October) and 19:30-22:30 with no days, and the Leading Hotels of the World and Meliá hotel pages that may list days refuse scripts (403).

alte-schule-klassenzimmer.note: The hotel's pages give only reception hours and closure dates

antonello-colonna-labico.note: Its site (every page and menu PDF) gives no days or times

aponiente.note: Its site and booking FAQ give no days or times (lunch and dinner, seasonal, closed over winter); the listings with hours copy Google's

blue-hill-at-stone-barns.note: No weekly pattern: Tock opens set dates only

callizo.note: Its own site (all pages, in three languages) and CoverManager page give no days or times, only 'Apertura prevista en marzo 2026'; Guía Repsol's page has an empty 'Horario', Go Aragón and Lonely Planet give none, and the only weekly hours found are on scraped directories (Foodle, Gastroranking) we can't use.

cenador-de-amos.note: Its site gives only the bookings desk's hours (Wednesday to Sunday); closed over Christmas, January and February

cocina-hermanos-torres.note: Its site gives only the phone desk's hours; the only press source with times (Time Out, Tuesday to Saturday lunch and dinner) is from 2018

cocinandos.note: Its own contact page gives times only (13:45-14:45 and 20:45-21:45, no days) and its CoverManager page none; Turismo Castilla y León's listings, Diario de León (Nov 2025) and Guía Repsol give no days, and Directo al Paladar's 'Horarios: cierra lunes' is too thin to say which other days (Sunday) it opens.

contrada.note: Only a year-old Internet Archive copy of the Leading Hotels of the World page gave times (Tue–Sat 19:30–21:30); the hotel's own site says just "dinner only"

de-heeren-van-harinxma.note: The Zenchef account that gives daily dinner 18:00–21:00 also holds the hotel's breakfast, lunch and afternoon tea, so it may not be this restaurant's alone

dolomieu.note: Seasonal (winter season from 6 December 2026, dinner only); DV Chalet's pages give no opening days

frases.note: Its own site (home, menu, booking, gift pages) and CoverManager page give no days or times; Guía Repsol's page has an empty 'Horario', Guía Repsol's 2023 article and Turismo de Murcia's 'Dónde comer' list give none, and the only hours found are the MICHELIN Guide's or scraped directories'.

il-cantuccio.note: The restaurant's site (home, Il Cantuccio & Menu, contacts, October 2026 menu PDF, booking form) gives no opening days or times; the only listings with days are the MICHELIN Guide and scraped directories (Pagine Gialle, eatbu, novacircle), none usable.

il-papavero.note: Its own site gives no days or times, and the only listings with days are reviews from 2017 and 2021, too old to rely on

il-piccolo-principe.note: The hotel's pages and menu PDF give no days or times; booking is a script-only widget

italo-bassi-confusion-restaurant.note: Seasonal (2026 season 23 April–29 September); its site gives no days or times and its booking form is switched off

kaiseki-morimoto.note: No website, social page or booking page (not on Ikyu, TableCheck, omakase.in, Pocket Concierge or OMAKASE)

kontrast.note: Its site gives no hours, its Superb booking page has a bot check and VisitOSLO's listing has none; the listings with hours copy the guide's

kvitnes-gard.note: Open nearly all year, dinner from 19:00, but no serving days given; its booking calendar needs a sign-in

la-verriere.note: Seasonal (7 May–3 October); Hôtel Marinca's pages give no days or times and its TheFork page has a bot check

mezra-yalkavak.note: Seasonal; its site gives no days or times and bookings for 2026 have closed

pico-velasco.note: Its site gives only the phone desk's hours; its TheFork widget has a captcha

retiro-da-costina.note: Its site gives hours for July and August only (Tue–Sat lunch and dinner, Sun lunch, Mon closed)

rodero.note: Rechecked restauranterodero.com (contacto, reservas, el restaurante, menus and the 2026 menu PDFs: no days or times; bookings by phone and email only) and searched Pamplona and Navarra tourism, Guía Repsol and press; the only listings with hours are an undated directory (salir.com: Tue lunch, Wed-Sat lunch and dinner) and a Feb 2025 travel blog with implausible all-day hours, neither usable.

shimbashi-sasada.note: No website and on no booking site; phone bookings only

shin-sushi.note: No website or booking page; phone bookings only

smoked-room-dubai.note: Temporarily closed, no reopening date given

sorn.note: Its site and TableCheck give only the phone line's hours; press listings disagree (Time Out 2025: Tuesday to Sunday)

stucki-tanja-grandits.note: Closed for rebuilding from 28 September 2026 until about November 2027

sylvestre-wahid-les-grandes-alpes.note: Closed after a fire in February 2026

ta-vie.note: Dinner 18:00–22:00 (seatings 18:00, 19:00, 20:00) on its reservation page, but its rest day varies by month, so no weekly pattern

under.note: Its own site gives dinner seatings (18:00–20:30) but no days, its booking page needs a robot check, and Visit Norway and its hotel's pages give no days

zass.note: Seasonal (Il San Pietro opens about April–October); its contact page's Monday–Saturday 11:00–23:00 look like phone hours, not service
